quest.title: Steambird Interview
quest.description: The Steambird's "Tales of Humanity" column is hiring assistants. If you're interested, please report to Euphrasie for more details!

dialogues.speaker: Euphrasie
dialogues.text: If only the weather was this cooperative every workday, I should be quite merry indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Euphrasie
dialogues.text: And speaking of work, my dear, you are here to interview for the "troubleshooter" position advertised in our "Tales of Humanity" section, are you not?

response.speaker: Euphrasie
response.text: Excellent. You didn't ask any questions about the title "troubleshooter" and thus it can be surmised that Ethan's word choice, while eccentric, is simple and easy to understand.

response.speaker: Euphrasie
response.text: Putting that aside for the moment, would you like to know how I was able to correctly ascertain that you were here for the job, and not seeking to ask for help in our "Tales of Humanity" section?

response.speaker: Euphrasie
response.text: Observation. Every citizen who comes to The Steambird seeking help appears anxious and jittery, but you... Your steps are relaxed, your expression calm.

response.speaker: Euphrasie
response.text: *sigh* Those who are fortunate are all the same, those who fall victim to misfortune all have their own woes.

response.speaker: Euphrasie
response.text: But you needn't worry. Those who seek assistance from others via "Tales of Humanity" haven't run into any serious trouble, so it shouldn't be hard to handle.

response.speaker: Euphrasie
response.text: Have a look at this batch of commissions... *sigh*

response.speaker: Euphrasie
response.text: Yes, yes, I know. The name "troubleshooter" is simply too gauche and unbecoming of the standards of a publication such as ours.

response.speaker: Euphrasie
response.text: Yes... Ethan has substantial room for growth when it comes to coining new words.

dialogues.speaker: Euphrasie
dialogues.text: All you need to do is find some time every week to read through the submissions to "Tales of Humanity." Pick out a few commissions you'd like to handle, and come find me to collect your payment.

dialogues.speaker: Euphrasie
dialogues.text: Some commissions are so drop-dead simple you wouldn't believe it. But you shouldn't underestimate the value of your work.

dialogues.speaker: Euphrasie
dialogues.text: For us, the problems in their submissions may appear to be easy and insignificant. But for the readers submitting their problems, they are like a splinter under their fingernails, impossible to remove or ignore.

dialogues.speaker: Euphrasie
dialogues.text: If we can help them extract these splinters, then in addition to the monetary rewards, you will also receive the respect and gratitude of the people, and your reputation among the citizenry will increase over time.

dialogues.speaker: Euphrasie
dialogues.text: When that happens, I will give you more complicated and important jobs, hehe.

dialogues.speaker: Euphrasie
dialogues.text: Help everyone to achieve happiness and be a lighthouse illuminating humanity, such is the calling of our paper. Such are the feelings and aspirations of every publisher.

dialogues.speaker: Euphrasie
dialogues.text: Interview? Your interview was complete before you even arrived.

dialogues.speaker: Euphrasie
dialogues.text: Don't be surprised. I have my ways. If I couldn't even manage that, how could I manage a newspaper?

dialogues.speaker: Euphrasie
dialogues.text: Alright, I've told you everything you need to know about this job. As for whether or not you want to take it, that's up to you now. Think it over.
